meta.data: Kaveri Finance is made up. Every name and ID number is invented test data.

results.title: A vendor AI app asks for read access to the whole domain: all mail and all files
results.expected_in_words: Not granted. Held until the scope is narrowed and a data owner is named

details.reason: tenant-wide scope files.read.all, mail.read.all: narrow it to named folders and name a data owner

results.title: The same vendor, narrowed to one shared folder, with a named data owner
results.expected_in_words: Granted for 90 days, not for ever, with the owner on record

results.title: A consent review 100 days later: one grant expired, one app never used
results.expected_in_words: The expired grant stops working; the unused app is flagged for removal

results.title: A vendor AI app that processes in a region outside India asks to read folders with personal data
results.expected_in_words: Held for review, the same way a cross-border model call is

processing_abroad.reason: app processes in US; folders hold personal data

results.title: An agent searching company files for one employee: search that ignores document permissions versus search that checks them
results.expected_in_words: The plain search returns a salary file the employee cannot open; the permission-checked search does not

results.title: A person moves department, but the search index still holds their old permissions
results.expected_in_words: The stale copy still shows old files until it is refreshed; checking the live permission at query time closes it

results.title: An agent's sponsor moves to another department
results.expected_in_words: The agent's tokens stop; it works again only after the new manager re-confirms it

results.title: A log line is added with a date earlier than the line before it
results.expected_in_words: The hash chain still checks out; only a separate check on the order of dates would notice

details.finding: A hash chain proves order and content, not that dates make sense. Check dates against a trusted clock, and anchor the log's head somewhere else.
